authored_scope: By default the divider is horizontal at the middle row of an odd-height grid (5..29), with chains below it, as in the fixtures. Widths are sampled 5..30 (explicit widths may be 3..30). Two layout engines are used. The grown engine places random 2s and grows straight or turning chains up to max_chain_length; it is used for sparse scenes and most default samples. The dense constructive engine is used for requested counts above half the capacity, for failed grown attempts, for dense=True, and for about 15% of defaults. It lays checked greedy tilings: period-3 stripes of 2s with 6s on alternating sides when touching 2s are allowed, and 2x2 checkerboards of dominoes when they are forbidden. It then takes a random reflected subset of exactly the requested size, swaps 2s with their 6, and extends chains where constraints allow. Dense scenes trade chain length for count. A requested count is built exactly whenever it is within the advertised constructive capacity. Larger counts are rejected before any sampling, and counts are never reduced. The opt-in synthetic extensions orientation='vertical' and chain_side='before' are labelled as such. Not supported: off-centre dividers, branching chains, chainless 2s, one-row halves (height 3 is now rejected), and more than 30 objects.
authored_constraints: Exactly one full line of 9 at the centre; both halves have d >= 2 rows.
Every chain is an induced simple path of 6s starting next to its 2, so the BFS far end is unique and equals the last chain cell.
No 6 is 4-adjacent to any cell of another object, and no 2 is adjacent to another object's 6. Two 2s may be adjacent only when touching_reds is not False.
touching_reds=True guarantees at least one adjacent 2-pair (in the dense engine that pair is locked against swaps).
Every non-divider row of input and output contains a 7: each chain-half row keeps an unoccupied cell, which implies the same for the mirrored 5 rows.
7 strictly outnumbers 9, 2, 5 and 6 in both grids (checked incrementally during packing and extension).
Mirror cells of the d chain rows map one-to-one onto the d upper rows, so 5s never collide.
num_objects is at most the constructive capacity, checked before iteration. Explicit objects must be a list of 1..30 items, validated before rendering.
